name: Surface
description: A traumatic head injury leaves Sophie with extreme memory loss. In her quest to put the pieces of her life back together—with help from her husband and friends—Sophie begins to question the truth behind her picture-perfect life.

videos.title: Ictus
videos.overview: Sophie's physical wounds have healed, but she's still plagued by memory loss and a feeling that her life is not as it seems.

videos.title: Muscle Memory
videos.overview: Her suspicions of her husband growing, Sophie attempts to get away from James and learn the real truth about their marriage.

videos.title: New Person, Same Old Mistakes
videos.overview: Caroline's betrayal has Sophie doubting who—and what—to believe. Sophie looks to Baden for answers, and a motive is finally revealed.

videos.title: Psychogenic
videos.overview: Sophie pushes the boundaries of her recovery, hoping to excavate the secrets buried deep in her mind.

videos.title: It Comes in Waves
videos.overview: A risky choice lands Sophie in the throes of a hallucinogenic trip that makes her question what kind of person she really is—or was.

videos.title: The Myth of California
videos.overview: James is finally honest with Sophie about their marriage and their past. His betrayals run deep, but not as deep as her own.

videos.title: It Was Always Going to End This Way
videos.overview: Sophie must end the investigation into her own crimes, and she realizes there's only one explanation left for what happened on the ferry.

videos.title: See You on the Other Side
videos.overview: Sophie seems ready to move forward, but can she accept a life with James while questions about her past still linger?

videos.title: New Money
videos.overview: Sophie makes a power play to establish herself in the Huntleys' world and reconnect with Eliza. A journalist contacts Sophie to be his source.

videos.title: Speak of the Devil
videos.overview: Eliza and Sophie rekindle their relationship. At Quinn and Grace's engagement party, tensions rise and an unexpected guest shows up.

videos.title: Kintsugi
videos.overview: Callum warns Sophie about the danger of trying to take down the Huntleys, as she deals with a new complication from her past.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Sophie returns to the Huntley estate—and makes a shocking discovery. James crosses paths with Quinn while trying to uncover Sophie's motives.

videos.title: Daybreak
videos.overview: Sophie tells James what she's discovered. Henry comes clean to Quinn and Eliza. Callum digs into Sophie's past and confronts her with the truth.

videos.title: Atonement
videos.overview: Henry arranges to meet with Sophie, hoping to buy her silence. Sophie turns to James for comfort. Callum questions who to trust.

videos.title: What Comes Around
videos.overview: James gets caught in the Huntleys' crosshairs as the walls close in on Sophie.

videos.title: Unearthed
videos.overview: The truth surfaces and leaves Sophie with one question: What's her next move?
